text: Currency exact multiply/divide (#6742) on fix/currency-exact-muldiv: Currency * and / (Y*N, N*Y, Y/N, N/Y, Y*Y, Y/Y) now use portable 128-bit integer arithmetic (no __int128, so MSVC/ARM match GCC/Clang), round half away at the 4th decimal, Number operands read as their exact shortest decimal; overflow stays 1988. Deliberate improvement over VFP9 (which loses digits through a double above 2^53 scaled units), labelled as such. Tested against 569 rows computed independently with Python Decimal (69 hand-picked + 500 seeded random); all existing VFP9-derived Currency rows unchanged. #6755 aggregates, then this, are the remaining cluster-25 items besides #6035 (64-bit external-function arithmetic, no VFP9 oracle) and #6038 (Access). Merged since last note: #6756 Currency VAL (closes #5996), #6758 TRANSFORM currency picture, #6759 DateTime Julian epoch (P0, #6757).
